top_signals.title: Emirates’ Clark Says Retirement Plans Derailed by Iran War
top_signals.summary: Emirates President Tim Clark said he was considering stepping away from the airline after achieving record profit earlier this year, but that plan was derailed by the start of the Iran war.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Oil Sinks to $94 as Iran’s $8 Billion Hormuz Deal Heads to Trump
top_signals.summary: Brent crude fell 3.6% to $94.00 per barrel on Monday as Qatar’s prime minister headed to the White House with an Iranian proposal for an interim deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. WTI dropped 3% to $88.09, and U.S. natural gas rose 0.8% to $3.02/MMBtu as of 7:26 a.m. ET. The decline extends last week’s 16% slide in Brent, the benchmark’s steepest weekly fall since the start of the Covid-19 pandemic. top_signals.title: ECB Succession Advances as Ministers Look to Pick Trio of Jobs
top_signals.summary: Euro-zone governments are looking to agree on the European Central Bank presidency with two other jobs after an initial stocktaking of candidates for the top role.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: ‘Connecting the dots’: Michael Saylor’s Strategy buys another 1,036 bitcoin for $82 million as holdings top 850,000 BTC
top_signals.summary: Strategy's total holdings account for more than 4% of bitcoin's supply cap, with $500 million in paper gains.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: SocGen’s Juckes Sees ‘Less Dollar-Friendly’ Year in 2027
top_signals.summary: Kit Juckes, chief FX strategist at Societe Generale, says he expects a weaker year for the dollar in 2027, "but I'd be really nervous about shorting the dollar until we can get past this energy crisis." He speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Could supplements be the next big opportunity in the GLP-1 weight-loss drug boom?
top_signals.summary: Novonesis is exploring whether gut health supplements could benefit patients taking GLP-1 weight-loss drugs, opening up a potentially lucrative new market.
